info.name: Enterprise Platform API — Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Enterprise Platform backend.

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Set `baseUrl` to your server (default: http://localhost:5000/api/v1)
3. Run **Login** — tokens auto-save to collection variables
4. All subsequent requests use the saved `{{accessToken}}` automatically

## Modules
- 🔐 Auth (register, login, 2FA, OAuth, sessions)
- 👤 Users, Roles & Permissions
- 📄 CMS (pages, menus, forms, testimonials)
- 🛠️ Services, Industries, Solutions
- 🖼️ Portfolio
- 📝 Blog & Resources
- 🤝 CRM (leads, meetings, proposals, pipeline)
- 📋 Projects, Tasks, Sprints, Time Tracking
- 💰 Finance (invoices, payments, expenses, subscriptions)
- 🏢 Clients & Portal
- 🎧 Support Tickets & Knowledge Base
- 👥 HR & Recruitment
- 🖼️ Media Library
- 🔔 Notifications
- 📊 Analytics
- 📣 Marketing (campaigns, subscribers, coupons)
- 🤖 AI Assistant
- ⚙️ System Settings, Webhooks, Feature Flags
